title: Some 'will-check to settle a companion dispute' prompts fail even at high investment (e.g. a +7 will bonus needing 11+ still failed once on a bad roll), which is fine as designed randomness, but the DC scaling after a failed narrative check (e.g. reading verses/tally marks) isn't clearly telegraphed as increasing each retry until you see it in the next menu.
